summary: Diameter Credit Company filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose that its board of trustees declared a quarterly dividend of $0.625 per common share of beneficial interest, par value $0.001. The dividend is payable November 16, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026; non-plan holders receive cash, while distribution reinvestment plan participants receive shares or a cash/share combination if elected. No special-situation transaction, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is present; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration and warrants no event-driven risk-arb angle.
